overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: 3D modeling techniques specific to VR — optimization pipelines for using these models in VR projects. Shown in live demonstrations for IDC IIT Bombay's Design in VR course.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Desktop 3D assets fail in headset — polycount, scale, and lighting break presence.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Modeled and optimized spatial assets for VR, covering the 3D pipeline from sculpt to engine-ready meshes.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Reusable VR modeling and optimization patterns, later demonstrated live for IDC IIT Bombay.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: 3D modeling techniques built for VR — optimization pipelines for spatial assets, taught and practiced across client and academic work.
